description: PHASE 4a item 5: the single authoritative heal RUN-GRAPH. Both the overnight (deadline-bounded) self-heal path and the attended/babysitter (midday, no-deadline) path MUST read this same graph so the two paths cannot silently diverge. The mode-equivalence preflight asserts both paths resolve to this graph before any spawn; a divergence exits nonzero BEFORE spawning anything. The graph is the ORDERED list of heal stages every path runs; modes differ ONLY in the allowed knobs declared in modeKnobs (deadline vs none, sequential vs parallel), never in which stages run or their order.
invariant: Both modes run every stage above, in this exact order. A mode may only differ in modeKnobs (deadline-bounded vs run-to-completion, sequential vs parallel fan-out). If either path's resolved stage list differs from this array, the mode-equivalence preflight fails and no worker is spawned.
